definition: How smoothly out-of-focus areas dissolve while the focus plane stays sharp.

not_the_same_as.vec_edge_softness: Edge softness is contour width on the subject. Bokeh is background dissolve.
not_the_same_as.vec_optical_softness: Optical softness melts the whole image. Bokeh softness is only the defocused field.

open_questions: Should architecture be excluded from bokeh tests, or is failure itself evidence?

prompt_phrases.high: very creamy bokeh, out-of-focus field fully dissolved, keep the subject plane sharp, no blur disks on in-focus surfaces
prompt_phrases.low: hard, nervous out-of-focus field, busy background edges, subject plane sharp
prompt_phrases.medium: moderately creamy background dissolve, subject plane still sharp

scoring_guidance: 0.00 hard busy bokeh, 0.50 moderate cream, 1.00 fully dissolved field with sharp subject.
testable_claim: Raising bokeh softness should melt only the out-of-focus field. The subject plane stays sharp. No disks on in-focus surfaces.
